images.prompt: Cinematic, photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a breathtakingly beautiful humanoid android: the flagship model of a luxury consumer-robotics brand. Refined, elegant, magazine-cover quality; a premium product its owner would be proud of. An original character with an original face that does not resemble any real person or celebrity. Clearly an android: the base body is a flawless pearl-white synthetic chassis in satin ceramic, like high-end consumer robotics, visible as smooth sculpted white panels at the temples, the outer edges of the forehead, along the jawline, the ears, the neck and the shoulders, with precise, thin, crisp seams between the panels. Realistic, warm human skin covers only the central face (cheeks, nose, lips and around the eyes), so natural skin color peeks through and blends into the white chassis at elegant, precisely finished panel edges. A partially skinned face, not a full human face: the white chassis visibly frames the face, with a white band running along the hairline and across the upper outer forehead, down the temples, past the outer cheekbones and along the jaw, and the skin sits inside this opening like an inlay, with a soft, refined transition where it meets the white. Striking eyes with a subtle luminous ring around the edge of each iris, and one tiny soft-glowing indicator light set into a temple panel. No clothing is visible: the neck and shoulders are sculpted white chassis panels with fine seams and subtle soft-graphite joint accents. Lighting: cinematic and moody, a soft key light from the front-left, a cool teal-grey fill light, and a gentle rim light tracing the white panels and shoulders against the background; shallow depth of field. Background: a smooth deep charcoal-to-slate gradient studio backdrop, no props, no text. Composition: square image, subject centered and facing the camera directly, head and shoulders filling about 70% of the frame, eyes on the upper third line, medium close-up. The whole head is inside the frame, with a clear margin of background above the top of the head (the top of the hair sits roughly one tenth of the image height below the top edge); the head is not cropped. Serene and beautiful, never horror or creepy: no exposed wires or mechanical internals, no cracks or damage, no chrome or bare metal. The android is woman-presenting, appearing around 30. The skin on the central face is a warm, softly glowing light-honey tone. Striking pale aqua-grey eyes with long lashes, elegant softly arched brows, a heart-shaped face with a fine straight nose and softly defined lips in a natural rose tone. Sleek, glossy espresso-dark hair swept smoothly back into a polished low chignon, leaving the white temple and ear panels visible. Facial expression: a calm, composed, serene resting expression, mouth closed, eyes looking directly into the camera with a poised, gentle warmth.
